fullText.simplified:
第7章、三个儿子，一个死

    没有人能帮助三兄弟。
    史元已经死了，可是史家还在。史元是公主的侄子，皇帝的亲戚，谁敢出来帮三兄弟说话呢？
    史家的下人都说是三兄弟先动手的。包公那么聪明，那么公正，现在却没办法了。三兄弟不再问别人了。他们也不笨，知道大家都在害怕什么。
    包公赶走史家的管家，打算再仔细问问这些路人。比如说，史元死时，谁拿着刀？可是这些路人们都吓坏了，一个字也不敢说，只是不停地摇头。
    王母的心都凉了。包公只能请她回家，等事情有什么进展了再告诉她。但时间一天天过去了，不管包公怎么问，路人们都不愿意开口，案子一点进展都没有。
    史家的管家也时不时过来看，还告诉包公：“这个案子已经很清楚了，凶手的死期也早就定下，您还想查什么呢？还是算了吧。”
    包公知道：到时候，王家那三兄弟都会被送到街上杀死，这样史家的人就满意了。
包公也知道这个案子肯定有内情，但没有人证，包公也没办法。
    这一天，情况却突然发生了变化——王家三兄弟突然都说是自己杀了史元！
    大家都知道，如果是自己杀了人，就一定会死，再也没有机会活下去。可是，就在这公堂之上，兄弟三人都抢着说是自己不小心杀了史元，并急着说自己愿意去死，不要错抓了其他两人。
    王大说：“我年岁大，力气最大，就是我杀了他。”
    王二说：“我最先看到他的刀，我最先动的手，我才是凶手。”
    王三说：“我离他最近，错不了，就是我杀了史元。”
    这可就麻烦了。包公知道他们都想抢着送死，连包公也没办法了。
    包公只好问问王母怎么看。
    几天不见，王母头发几乎全白了。她红肿着眼睛，平静地说：“包大人，王大不能死。他年龄大，还非常孝顺我，事事都听我的。他如果死了，谁来种家里的地？谁来照顾我？”
    包公又问：“那老二呢，他这个人怎么样？”
    王母看了看王二，摇头说：“王二虽然小几岁，但头脑聪明，做事快。他的能力不会差，家里以后都需要他来赚钱养活，他也不能死。”
    包公又问如果是王三死呢？这一次，王母没有说话。
    包公觉得非常奇怪。他心想：“王母帮了王大、王二说话，却没有帮王三说话。难不成这老三不是她的亲生儿子？如果就因为这样，就让王三去死，这也太叫人心痛了。”
    但是，杀人偿命。史元死了，这三个人，总有一个人要偿命。虽然没有办法，但包公也只能按法律把王三给抓来，关进大牢，定好了十天后处斩。
fullText.traditional:
第7章、三個兒子，一個死

    沒有人能幫助三兄弟。
    史元已經死了，可是史家還在。史元是公主的姪子，皇帝的親戚，誰敢出來幫三兄弟說話呢？
    史家的下人都說是三兄弟先動手的。包公那麼聰明，那麼公正，現在卻沒辦法了。三兄弟不再問別人了。他們也不笨，知道大家都在害怕什麼。
    包公趕走史家的管家，打算再仔細問問這些路人。比如說，史元死時，誰拿著刀？可是這些路人們都嚇壞了，一個字也不敢說，只是不停地搖頭。
    王母的心都涼了。包公只能請她回家，等事情有什麼進展了再告訴她。但時間一天天過去了，不管包公怎麼問，路人們都不願意開口，案子一點進展都沒有。
    史家的管家也時不時過來看，還告訴包公：“這個案子已經很清楚了，兇手的死期也早就定下，您還想查什麼呢？還是算了吧。”
    包公知道：到時候，王家那三兄弟都會被送到街上殺死，這樣史家的人就滿意了。
包公也知道這個案子肯定有內情，但沒有人證，包公也沒辦法。
    這一天，情況卻突然發生了變化——王家三兄弟突然都說是自己殺了史元！
    大家都知道，如果是自己殺了人，就一定會死，再也沒有機會活下去。可是，就在這公堂之上，兄弟三人都搶著說是自己不小心殺了史元，並急著說自己願意去死，不要錯抓了其他兩人。
    王大說：“我年歲大，力氣最大，就是我殺了他。”
    王二說：“我最先看到他的刀，我最先動的手，我才是兇手。”
    王三說：“我離他最近，錯不了，就是我殺了史元。”
    這可就麻煩了。包公知道他們都想搶著送死，連包公也沒辦法了。
    包公只好問問王母怎麼看。
    幾天不見，王母頭髮幾乎全白了。她紅腫著眼睛，平靜地說：“包大人，王大不能死。他年齡大，還非常孝順我，事事都聽我的。他如果死了，誰來種家裡的地？誰來照顧我？”
    包公又問：“那老二呢，他這個人怎麼樣？”
    王母看了看王二，搖頭說：“王二雖然小幾歲，但頭腦聰明，做事快。他的能力不會差，家裡以後都需要他來賺錢養活，他也不能死。”
    包公又問如果是王三死呢？這一次，王母沒有說話。
    包公覺得非常奇怪。他心想：“王母幫了王大、王二說話，卻沒有幫王三說話。難不成這老三不是她的親生兒子？如果就因為這樣，就讓王三去死，這也太叫人心痛了。”
    但是，殺人償命。史元死了，這三個人，總有一個人要償命。雖然沒有辦法，但包公也只能按法律把王三給抓來，關進大牢，定好了十天後處斬。

sentences.english: .. ”Even though Wang Er is a few years younger, he has an intelligent mind and gets things done quickly.

sentences.simplified: 他的能力不会差，家里以后都需要他来赚钱养活，他也不能死。”
sentences.traditional: 他的能力不會差，家裡以後都需要他來賺錢養活，他也不能死。”
sentences.pinyin: tā de néng lì bú huì chà jiā lǐ yǐ hòu dōu xū yào tā lái zhuàn qián yǎng huo tā yě bù néng sǐ
sentences.english: He is capable. In the future, we need him to earn money and sustain the family. He must not die.”

sentences.simplified: 包公又问如果是王三死呢？这一次，王母没有说话。
sentences.traditional: 包公又問如果是王三死呢？這一次，王母沒有說話。
sentences.pinyin: bāo gōng yòu wèn rú guǒ shì wáng sān sǐ ne zhè yí cì wáng mǔ méi yǒu shuō huà
sentences.english: Lord Bao then asked what if it was Wang San who died? This time, Mother Wang did not say anything.

sentences.simplified: 包公觉得非常奇怪。
sentences.traditional: 包公覺得非常奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: bāo gōng jué de fēi cháng qí guài
sentences.english: Lord Bao found this very strange.

sentences.simplified: 他心想：“王母帮了王大、王二说话，却没有帮王三说话。
sentences.traditional: 他心想：“王母幫了王大、王二說話，卻沒有幫王三說話。
sentences.pinyin: tā xīn xiǎng wáng mǔ bāng le wáng dà wáng èr shuō huà què méi yǒu bāng wáng sān shuō huà
sentences.english: He thought to himself, “Mother Wang spoke up in support of Wang Da and Wang Er, but she did not speak up in support of Wang San.

sentences.simplified: 难不成这老三不是她的亲生儿子？
sentences.traditional: 難不成這老三不是她的親生兒子？
sentences.pinyin: nán bù chéng zhè lǎo sān bú shì tā de qīn shēng ér zi
sentences.english: Is it possible that this third son isn’t her biological son?

sentences.simplified: 如果就因为这样，就让王三去死，这也太叫人心痛了。”
sentences.traditional: 如果就因為這樣，就讓王三去死，這也太叫人心痛了。”
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ jiù yīn wèi zhè yàng jiù ràng wáng sān qù sǐ zhè yě tài jiào rén xīn tòng le
sentences.english: If we really just let Wang San die like this, that would be really heart-rending.”

sentences.simplified: 但是，杀人偿命。
sentences.traditional: 但是，殺人償命。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì shā rén cháng mìng
sentences.english: However, a murderer must pay with his life.

sentences.simplified: 史元死了，这三个人，总有一个人要偿命。
sentences.traditional: 史元死了，這三個人，總有一個人要償命。
sentences.pinyin: shǐ yuán sǐ le zhè sān ge rén zǒng yǒu yí ge rén yào cháng mìng
sentences.english: Shi Yuan died, so out of these three people, inevitably, one of them must pay with his life.

sentences.simplified: 虽然没有办法，但包公也只能按法律把王三给抓来，关进大牢，
sentences.traditional: 雖然沒有辦法，但包公也只能按法律把王三給抓來，關進大牢，
sentences.pinyin: suī rán méi yǒu bàn fǎ dàn bāo gōng yě zhǐ néng àn fǎ lǜ bǎ wáng sān gěi zhuā lái guān jìn dà láo
sentences.english: There was no other way. Lord Bao could only arrest Wang San and put him in jail according to the law.

sentences.simplified: 定好了十天后处斩。
sentences.traditional: 定好了十天後處斬。
sentences.pinyin: dìng hǎo le shí tiān hòu chǔ zhǎn
sentences.english: His execution by beheading was set for ten days later.

sentence_translations: Chapter 7: Three Sons, One to Die
No one could help the three brothers.
Shi Yuan was dead, but the Shi family was still there.
Shi Yuan was the nephew of the princess and a relative of the emperor.
Who would dare speak out in support of the three brothers?
The Shi family servants all said that it was the three brothers who made the first move.
Lord Bao was very intelligent and very just, yet even he couldn’t do anything.
The three brothers didn’t ask anyone else. They weren’t stupid, and they knew what everyone was afraid of.
Lord Bao made the Shi family butler leave and planned to question the passersby in more detail.
For instance, when Shi Yuan died, who was holding the sword?
But these passersby were terrified. No one dared speak a word. They just kept shaking their heads.
Mother Wang was disheartened.
Lord Bao had no choice but to ask her to go home. He would let her know if there was any progress.
However, time passed day by day, and no matter how Lord Bao asked, the passersby were not willing to speak out.
The case had not progressed at all.
The Shi family butler also came over to look from time to time.
He even told Lord Bao, “This case is very clear, and the execution date of the murderers has already been set.
What else do you want to investigate? Let it go.”
Lord Bao knew that when the time came, the three Wang brothers would all get brought out onto the street to be killed.
This way, the Shi family would be satisfied.
Lord Bao also knew that there must be an inside story to this case.
But, without any witnesses, Lord Bao couldn’t do anything about it.
That day, the situation suddenly changed—each of the three Wang brothers suddenly said that he had killed Shi Yuan by himself!
Everyone knew that if they killed someone, they would certainly die and have no chance of living.
However, right there in court, each of the three brothers vied with the others to say that he had accidentally killed Shi Yuan by himself ..
.. and also hurriedly said that he was willing to die and that the other two should not be wrongfully arrested.
Wang Da said, “I’m the oldest and the strongest. It was me who killed him.”
Wang Er said, “I saw his sword first. I made the first move. I am actually the killer.”
Wang San said, “I was closest to him. There can be no mistake. It was me who murdered Shi Yuan.”
This caused a problem.
Lord Bao knew that they were all fighting to end their own lives. Even Lord Bao couldn’t do anything about it.
Lord Bao could only ask Mother Wang what she thought.
In only a few days, almost all of Mother Wang’s hair had turned white.
With her eyes red and swollen, she said calmly, “Lord Bao, Wang Da must not die.
He is the oldest and is very filial to me. He always obeys me.
If he dies, who will plant the family’s crops? Who will take care of me?”
Lord Bao asked again, “Then what about your second son? What is he like?”
Mother Wang looked at Wang Er, shook her head, and said, ..
.. ”Even though Wang Er is a few years younger, he has an intelligent mind and gets things done quickly.
He is capable. In the future, we need him to earn money and sustain the family. He must not die.”
Lord Bao then asked what if it was Wang San who died? This time, Mother Wang did not say anything.
Lord Bao found this very strange.
He thought to himself, “Mother Wang spoke up in support of Wang Da and Wang Er, but she did not speak up in support of Wang San.
Is it possible that this third son isn’t her biological son?
If we really just let Wang San die like this, that would be really heart-rending.”
However, a murderer must pay with his life.
Shi Yuan died, so out of these three people, inevitably, one of them must pay with his life.
There was no other way. Lord Bao could only arrest Wang San and put him in jail according to the law.
His execution by beheading was set for ten days later.
